cards.front: Recall a key point about The Athenian Empire (Delian League)
cards.back: The Delian League was founded in 478 BC as a defensive alliance against Persia, with Athens as leader (hegemon)

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Athenian Empire (Delian League)
cards.back: Member states contributed ships or money (phoros/tribute) stored on the island of Delos at the League's treasury

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Athenian Empire (Delian League)
cards.back: Athens gradually transformed the League into an empire: moved the treasury to Athens (454 BC), forced members to use Athenian coinage and courts

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Athenian Empire (Delian League)
cards.back: States that tried to leave (e.g. Naxos, Thasos) were forcibly prevented; the League became an instrument of Athenian control

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Athenian Empire (Delian League)
cards.back: Athens used tribute to fund its navy and building programme (Parthenon), effectively spending allied money on itself

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Athenian Empire (Delian League)
cards.back: The Erythrae decree shows Athens directly controlling member cities' legal and political affairs
